home_contract.focus: Person's today; no required initial Project selection and no fixed Project-first hierarchy
home_contract.question_threshold: ask only if an answer materially changes safety, inclusion, rank or next step
home_contract.missing_information: show insufficient information or degrade; do not imply knowledge or press for an answer

feedback_contract.recording: append Feedback and preserve reasoning/evidence chain
feedback_contract.generalization: only an explicitly confirmed, scoped, revocable rule may influence later contexts
feedback_contract.automation: no suggestion automatically creates or executes an action
